scanner_rule.description: ThreeWood: block nonexistent CMS, secret and repository probes
scanner_rule.expression: (http.host in {"threewood.app" "www.threewood.app"}) and (starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-admin") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-includes/") or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-login.php" or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/.git") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/.env") or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/xmlrpc.php" or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/phpmyadmin"))

scope: No broad Bot Fight Mode, country blocks, paid plan upgrades, or game-asset rate limits. Preserve existing rules.
